facts: CobraVisualTheme.data is assigned only in its private constructor. Its three callers builtin/loadGeneration/storePrepared construct/load private JSON.
After construction, the actual data consumers Theme.value, Renderer.displayName, Safety.effectiveManifest and Activity.cobraBrowseSystemBarSurfaceColor only read it.
Renderer get/guideLayout exposes JSON aliases but actual consumers only read them; Geometry.guide copies values into model arrays. Renderer.stylesFor writes only its new result JSONObject.
Theme store/keep/reset/rollback pointer mutations concern separate newly-created pointer JSON, not the active theme data.
Renderer.active is written only in class initialization and its publish callback; publication swaps the theme then refreshes clients.

Fresh effective theme identity plus palette, loaded UI contract identity/stamp and computed configuration/geometry therefore validate the current431 immutable-after-construction contract. No JSON/inventory hash or new disk poll is needed.
required_for_next_owner: These four existing classes remain canonically exact; do not silently retain this proof after changing them.
